# [pixi](../index.md) [audit](index.md) ignore

Record ignore rules in the `[workspace.audit]` table of the manifest

--8<-- "docs/reference/cli/pixi/audit/ignore_extender:description"

## Usage
```
pixi audit ignore [OPTIONS] [ID]...
```

## Arguments
- <a id="arg-ID" href="#arg-ID">`<ID>`</a>
:  Advisory ids or aliases to ignore. With `--package`, only in that package; without any id, `--package` ignores every advisory of the package
<br>May be provided more than once.

## Options
- <a id="arg---package" href="#arg---package">`--package <NAME>`</a>
:  Limit the rule to this package, or ignore every advisory of it
- <a id="arg---ecosystem" href="#arg---ecosystem">`--ecosystem <ECOSYSTEM>`</a>
:  Limit the rule to this ecosystem (`conda-forge` or `PyPI`)
- <a id="arg---version" href="#arg---version">`--version <VERSION>`</a>
:  Limit the rule to this locked version
- <a id="arg---up-to-version" href="#arg---up-to-version">`--up-to-version <VERSION>`</a>
:  Limit the rule to locked versions up to and including this one
- <a id="arg---until-fixed" href="#arg---until-fixed">`--until-fixed`</a>
:  Ignore the advisories only while no fixed release newer than the locked version is reported in the package's own ecosystem. Requires advisory ids
- <a id="arg---reason" href="#arg---reason">`--reason <TEXT>`</a>
:  Why the advisories are ignored
- <a id="arg---expired-at" href="#arg---expired-at">`--expired-at <DATE>`</a>
:  The last day, in UTC, on which the rule applies (`YYYY-MM-DD`)
